prompt: A massive humanoid creature made of dark loamy soil, grass-turf, knotted tree-roots and embedded mossy boulders, heaving itself up out of the forest floor in a hunched crouch, facing south-west. The ground in front of it is torn open into a fresh earthen pit where its body pulled loose, loose dirt and severed roots dangling. Two faint amber lights glow where its eyes form. The background is a deep old-growth forest of emerald canopy and brown trunks. Earthy green and ash-brown palette.

A towering golem made entirely of grassy turf, dark soil, dangling tree-roots and lichen-covered stones, rising upright and tearing itself free from the ground, dirt and roots cascading off its shoulders. Beneath it gapes a raw earthen crater where the land pulled loose. Glowing amber eyes set deep in its mossy head. Side profile facing east. The background is a sunlit forest clearing with a wall of emerald trees. Deep green and loam-brown palette.

A broad grassy hillock in a forest meadow that has awakened into a living creature: the slope of the mound has resolved into a vast craggy face of soil and stone, two huge glowing amber eyes cracking open, roots writhing like veins across its turf-covered brow, a mouth of jagged rock parting in the hillside. Wide low mound spanning the frame. The background is distant pine forest under a pale dawn sky. Mossy green and earth-brown palette.
